latest_release.name: v0.19.0
latest_release.body:
自 v0.18.0 以来，dsh-TUI 跟上 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` 验证线，让一次 `/update` 同时对齐 TUI、全局 dsh 引擎与全局启动器，
并修好会话恢复、btw 输入、子代理失败提示与 Codex 后端命令输出等一批问题。

## 亮点

- **适配 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`** — npm 上的 DSH `latest` 已是 `0.2.2-rc.1`，而 v0.18.0 的精确 peer 只到 `0.2.1-rc.5`，升级 DSH 后 TUI 会被判 incompatible 并 skip。本版把 `0.2.2-rc.1` 加入验证线与 peer 范围，`0.2.1-rc.5` 及其之前的验证线继续保留；模型选择改用上游的会话级 `Agent.model` 接缝、工具限制落到每个 Agent 的作用域、适配 cordis 4.1 生命周期与固定动作审批，旧宿主继续走原来的选择引用与请求瀑布。([#1886](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1886) by @Lucas2011wastaken)
- **一次 `/update` 对齐 TUI、dsh 引擎与全局启动器** — 以前 `/update` 只换 profile 里的 TUI，全局 dsh 与启动器留在原地，可能出现新 TUI 的 peer 范围装不上当前引擎。现在预检为三层解析同一份计划，按 TUI → 引擎 → 启动器串行执行：引擎只选目标 TUI peer 范围内已发布的最高版本（永不降级、不选 alpha 线），装完用 profile 模块解析与 `dsh --version` 验证；启动器只动能证明归属的全局安装，多成员 pnpm 组、项目内依赖与有歧义的别名一律不改。TUI 已是最新时也不再短路，仍会补齐引擎与启动器；引擎安装失败后只有能证明启动的入口才允许重启，跳过原因会留在下一次挂载的屏幕与警告里。([#1847](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1847)、[#1849](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1849) by @Lucas2011wastaken；[#1889](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1889) by @AdamPlatin123)
- **子代理通道整体失败会明说** — 同一 provider 的已结算运行至少失败 2 次且失败过半时，子代理列表上方出现通道降级提示，并建议切换 provider；只有可切换的 `claude-code` / `codex` 通道会提示，内建 `subagent`、workflow 与 teammate 行不误报。([#1794](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1794) by @MomentDerek)

## 需要留意的行为变化

- **权限问卷只提供固定动作** — 在 DSH 0.2.2 上，`approval` 类问题只提供调用方声明的选项，不再有自由文本入口；普通问卷仍可自由输入。([#1886](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1886) by @Lucas2011wastaken)
- **`/update` 的拒绝语义与逃生开关** — 新 TUI 要升级、而**当前运行**的引擎不在它的 peer 范围内时，即使引擎可以自动升级也会先拒绝，并打印「先升级引擎，再重新 `/update`」的命令（官方加载校验按运行中的 dsh 判定）；引擎装完校验不通过时不重启，但保留已升级的 TUI。`DSH_TUI_UPDATE_ENGINE=0` 钉住引擎，`DSH_TUI_UPDATE_LAUNCHER=0` 跳过启动器，`DSH_TUI_DSH_PM=npm|pnpm` 覆盖包管理器判定。([#1849](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1849) by @Lucas2011wastaken；[#1889](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1889) by @AdamPlatin123)
- **`/restart` 带回图片，被后端丢弃的输入不再自动重发** — 交接文件从纯文本改为带图片的输入；被判定「确定没执行」的输入会暂存为未送达，由用户决定是否重发。([#1764](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1764) by @MomentDerek)
- **长会话不再重放打字动画，代价是随历史线性增长的内存** — 已完成行的记账不再有 2048 条上限（几万行量级约十几 MB），随会话释放。([#1796](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1796) by @MomentDerek)
- **btw 输入框恒为一行** — 长草稿围绕光标开窗、被裁一侧显示 `…`，不再折行；只支持左右查看，不支持多行编辑。([#1866](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1866) by @Lucas2011wastaken)
- **Linux 进程名显示为 `dsh-tui`** — `ps -o comm`、`top` 与系统监视器不再显示 `MainThread`；`/proc/<pid>/cmdline` 保持不变。([#1841](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1841) by @Lucas2011wastaken)
- **rio 与 Orca 启用扩展键编码** — 两者加入 `CSI >1u` 白名单，`Shift+Enter` 与修饰键组合可用；名单出问题时可用 `DSH_TUI_FORCE_EXTENDED_KEYS=1` / `DSH_TUI_DISABLE_EXTENDED_KEYS=1` 强制或禁用（disable 优先）。([#1821](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1821) by @Plintash；[#1840](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1840) by @Lucas2011wastaken)

## 修复

- **会话与恢复**：会话管理页去掉每个 project 下方重复且容易截断的路径、全部来源统一单行列表，并修好快速连点两个 project 时第二击被当成选词的问题（多击判定现在要求同一个 `onClick` 祖先）；从整屏界面返回或 `/resume` 后历史消息不再逐条重新「打字」；会话自身收尾的回合显示「会话已停止」而不是用户中断；Linux 上被其他进程复用的旧线程 ID 不再让空闲会话被误判为被占用。([#1755](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1755) by @xuzijian2019；[#1796](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1796)、[#1764](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1764) by @MomentDerek；[#1769](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1769)、[#1770](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1770) by @FlameTN7)
- **输入与面板**：窄侧栏 btw 草稿不再被挤成 0 宽或按未截断的草稿撑高，尾部和硬件光标留在框内；不带 bracketed-paste 标记的整块文本也先压平成单行。([#1866](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1866) by @Lucas2011wastaken)
- **子代理与后端**：Codex 后端下 `/usage`、`/diff` 查询成功后会显示输出，补全菜单里按 `Enter` 直接执行而不用先补空格。([#1775](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1775) by @MomentDerek)
- **终端兼容**：Orca 与 rio 的扩展键、Kitty 小键盘码位 57416–57426 补齐，CSI-u 的非打印键不再被当作文本插入。([#1840](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1840)、[#1841](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1841) by @Lucas2011wastaken；[#1821](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1

English | 简体中文

# dsh-TUI > An interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness. It ships a pixel-whale > header, live work status, streaming thinking, double-Esc time rewind, a > context progress bar, and a TPS gauge. Zero core changes: it consumes only > DSH's public exports, and is moving from a mounted plugin to an app with its > own entry and composition root, where DSH loads in process as the first-party > backend. Install to enable; uninstall leaves no patches behind. The prompt footer hides completed goals once the turn is idle; the Todo side panel retains their history. `Ctrl+Q` folds todos while working and hides/restores the idle goal/todo footer. Clicking its todo header also hides it while idle. Hiding changes only this display: a new goal/todo snapshot or session reveals it again, and `/goal clear` does not clear todos. Split diff cards give one-sided additions and deletions the full body width, without an empty opposite pane. Ordinary edits remain side by side, and mixed files choose their layout separately before folding or streaming reveal. Compaction status stays on one line in narrow panes: phase and cancellation hints yield first, then the label is shortened; elapsed time is shown only as a complete field. Image files referenced with `@path` use the same admission and resize/conversion policy as pasted images. Adjustment notices report the stored dimensions and format; required animation conversion is refused instead of dropping frames. Mention images and staged images still share count and stored-byte limits in source order. ## Highlights Panels without a verified Component identity are temporary: settings show their title and a distinct number for this run. Their toggles take effect immediately without being saved, and unrelated settings changes preserve that choice. Old `actN:panel` entries cannot be mapped safely: remove the placeholder and select the current panel again. Verified Components named `actN` keep their public runtime address; an explicit selection uses `component:actN:panel` in saved preferences to avoid claiming an old anonymous entry. The default reasoning-effort setting offers the current backend/model’s declared tiers, including custom IDs. Saved values absent from that catalog stay visible and stored; while loading or unavailable, only Auto is selectable. On DSH, Auto follows the saved `/effort` choice, then the configured effort, then the model default. Claude/Codex retain backend preferences for Auto at startup and for resumed sessions; explicitly choosing Auto resets the model default. Explicit settings changes affect the next request; unsupported preferences fall back with a notice and are never forced onto a route. Resuming a DSH session preserves its recorded reasoning effort (or its live selection when reattaching). The saved default seeds new sessions; explicit `/effort` and effort-default settings changes still apply to the current session’s next request. - **Pixel whale pet** — three startup intros, click to wake; freezes after the first task. - **Launchpad and first-run guide** — every ordinary launch lands on a landing page with a **real input box** (big text + whale + quick actions, dropping whole blocks on short/narrow terminals; whale-girl images use a compact native-canvas footprint instead of leaving a large gap before the title; on by default — /settings `launchpad` off boots straight into chat); command completion matches chat: `Tab` fills the input, `Enter` runs the command and clears it. The first run walks a four-step wizard (accounts & models / language+theme / model+workspace / shortcuts), re-runnable with `/setup`; its first step signs in to a subscription and catches the models it brings in (none → no question, one → that one, several → you choose), or adds an API key through the `/provider` wizard, which asks which of the enabled models to switch to or keeps the current one. - **Terminal-native UI** — streaming Markdown, tool cards, `/` and `@` completion, `#L12-14` ranges, history search, zh/en UI. - **Task completion notifications** — DSH, Claude and Codex notify after successful live work settles, with no queued follow-up or active goal. The title is “dsh-TUI · Task complete”; the body shows the latest settled reply as a single-line plain-text preview (Markdown formatting removed, up to 200 characters). OSC 777/9 apply an additional 2048-byte sequence budget, including title and protocol bytes, preserving whole graphemes. No reply shows only the title; BEL only rings. `/settings` → Conversation: `taskNotifications` = `unfocused` (default), `always`, or `off`; `notificationMethod` = `auto` (default), `osc9`, `bel`, or `windows`. Auto uses separate title/body fields on Ghostty/WezTerm (OSC 777) and Kitty (OSC 99); iTerm2/Warp and explicit `osc9` use a title prefix; other terminals ring the bell; delivery follows your terminal's notification/bell settings. On local Windows, `auto` resolves to `windows`, the system's native notifications: a task-completion toast. The first toast registers that user's AppUserModelID under HKCU, the toast appears about 3 seconds after the task ends (the PowerShell cold start that buys the no-extra-install route), and for DSH sessions an enabled, active external DSH notification plugin in the running profile makes dsh-TUI yield to it (no toast, no bell); an installed but disabled plugin does not suppress notifications; if that AppUserModelID cannot be written, the notification falls back to the bell instead of going silent. `jumpBack` (Windows, off by default) turns those completion toasts into a way back to the pane that finished; it needs the native toast path (`notificationMethod` = `windows`, which `auto` picks on local Windows). With `/settings` → Conversation → `jumpBack` on, the pane title ends with `[dsh-tui:<16 hex>]`, one marker for the life of the process; switching it off removes the suffix at once. While it is on, this process refreshes a marker file at `~/.dsh-tui/notify/jumpback/.json` (`schemaVersion: 1`, `marker`, `pid`, `startedAt`) when the setting is turned on and before each completion it sends, and the first toast that can promise a jump registers the per-user protocol handler (`URL Protocol` plus `shell\open\command`) under `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-tui`; a normal exit removes the file, and removes the key once no other live instance still needs it. Only a pre-send probe that finds exactly one target pane (or tab title) puts an activation URI on the toast; clicking it re-runs five checks — same pane, keyboard focus, marker still in the title, foreground window, not minimized — and refuses rather than jumping anywhere else when any of them fails. A click whose target has gone away changes nothing. Layouts that cannot be verified — a pane in an unselected tab that is not that tab's focused pane, profiles using `suppressApplicationTitle`, and terminals other than Windows Terminal (tested on Windows Terminal 1.24) — get a plain toast whose click changes nothing. The probe adds about half a second before each toast; the first one after enabling can also wait for the helper to compile (a few seconds, once), and a machine whose in-box compiler keeps failing retries it at most every five minutes. External notification senders can read the same marker file and point their own toast at `dsh-tui:activate?m=`; the URI and file format are a read-only contract, and this release ships no plugin-side implementation. SSH sessions keep the attached terminal's notification protocol in `auto` mode; explicit `windows` still selects the host's native transport. tmux requires `set -g allow-passthrough on` for OSC notifications and `set -g focus-events on` for focus reporting. Terminals without focus reporting need `always`. Replay, cancellation and failures do not notify. Works in inline and fullscreen modes. - **Native cursor** — focused text inputs inherit your terminal's cursor shape, color, blinking, and enabled animation or trail effects in both inline and fullscreen modes. The `/model` picker shows the same cursor during movement between provider tabs, model rows, and effort levels, then hides it after **0.5 seconds at rest**; clipped regions fall back to the model row. The session manager also moves this cursor between the workspace rail, session rows, and search box; typing claims the search caret, and navigation returns it to the focused row. Configure animation and trail effects in your terminal. - **Images** — Kitty/Sixel thumbnails, centered preview with zoom and pan, paste-time fitting, text fallback. Kitty images scale to the reserved cells' physical pixels, including on HiDPI terminals. - **Mermaid diagrams** — ````mermaid ```` fences drawn as Unicode diagrams. - **LaTeX math** — `$…$` and `$$…$$` formulas as Unicode text, fractions and limits stacked in display blocks; `mathRendering: image` typesets block and one-row inline formulas as terminal images on graphics terminals. - **Timeline rail** — every turn clickable; timeline / scrollbar / hidden gutter. - **Side panel** — `Ctrl+B` splits the chat with a panel column once the terminal is wide enough; drag the divider to resize it. All eight built-in panels are enabled by default, and so are plugin panels registered later (`sidePanel.panels: '*'`; untick a row in `/settings` to switch to an explicit list). The header shows each inactive panel's symbol; hover to see its name. Narrow terminals and inline mode keep full-screen panels. In the `todo` panel a long goal wraps to the panel width with its phase on a separate row; when the content exceeds the viewport, focus the panel and scroll with `↑`/`↓` or the wheel (every todo is reachable too) (the compact goal row above the chat input stays a single truncated line with a hover tooltip). - **Live state** — activity animation, context bar, TPS, cache hit rate, effort, tokens, session cost estimate (main + subagents), Git and session metadata. Title, trajectory-strip and session-state animations update independently of the transcript and pause when idle or unfocused. Context-bar fill follows backend occupancy; colors estimate content composition. Compaction clears obsolete estimates, and missing composition displays a single used block with a measured used count in both hover details. - **One session manager** — `/resume` `/home` `/agentview` `/bg` `⌸`. - **Session workflow** — `/new` `/compact` `/export` `/btw`, model hot-switch, fork, rewind, vim, fullscreen draft editor. `/btw` uses an overlay when its sidebar cannot render. Main-task questionnaires and the fullscreen draft editor take priority while preserving the side question and draft. - **IDE selection channel** — a VS Code selection lands in the prompt. - **DSH integrations** — presets, skills, MCP, goals, todos, subagents, questionnaires. - **Account sign-in** — the standard profile offers pi-ai OAuth for ChatGPT/Codex, Claude, and Grok (plus OpenAI direct and Meta Muse when available), and Host-owned DeepSeek browser sign-in as `deepseek-account` on DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+. Use `/provider` or `/auth` without another plugin. A profile-only update from a global TUI patch that already mounts `dsh-tui-auth` can still start the official loopback callback listener on demand; fixed-port SSH forwarding still requires the global package to be aligned. - **Extensions** — browser interaction, computer use and more. - **Built for long sessions** — event-driven projection, virtualization, bounded caches. Keys and commands: [Interaction and commands](docs/interaction.en.md). Everything else: [documentation index](docs/README.md). Plugin side panels stay enabled when unrelated settings change. Editing the enabled panel list still applies your explicit selection. Workspace side-panel counts match the session manager: the current conversation counts; empty logs, subagents, fork ancestors and archived sessions do not. Registered workspaces with no visible conversations remain at zero. Loading and read errors are shown separately; press `r` to refresh. When a DSH 0.2.1+ Agent moves its session to another directory (the `working_directory` tool or a Git worktree), the status line, Git branch, `@` completion, `!` commands, clicked paths, skill commands and loaded context follow it, including after `/resume`. The session stays registered under the project it started in. Relative paths in cards rendered before a move resolve against the session's current directory when clicked; absolute paths keep their target. Fullscreen mouse selection stays in the pane where the gesture starts, including chat, sidebar and either diff column. Diagonal, word and line selection copy that pane’s text; soft wraps join independently, source newlines remain, and divider drags only resize. ## Preview
## Featured & Listed Among the community plugins recommended by the **official lead of DeepSeek Harness**, dsh-TUI is the first. Featured by the **DeepSeek Harness official WeChat account**, listed in the [dshfind](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI) plugin directory, and ranked **#7 on [GitHub Trending](https://trendshift.io/repositories/146168) daily** (TypeScript).

## Quick Start ### Windows one-click installer (x64) Download `dsh-tui-setup-win-x64.exe` from [Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/releases) and run it. Per-user, no administrator, fully offline, and no preinstalled Node or DSH. ### Command-line installation Prerequisites: [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en) and [deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). The `deepseek-official` API-key route needs `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. On DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+, the standard profile can instead use `/auth login deepseek-account` and select the separate account route through `/model`. Other supported accounts can sign in through `/provider` or `/auth` after startup. The primary compatibility target is DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`. This adapter supports its Shell API, V4 session messages, declarative presets, and profile-backed settings; older supported hosts retain their compatibility paths. See [configuration](docs/configuration.en.md). On DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and later, `/settings` also selects DeepSeek Search / Fetch APIs and edits their endpoint and result limits, supporting custom Loader entry IDs and a masked API key input saved through DSH's credential store. Official Flash model labels show the `1017` release marker while retaining the `deepseek-flash` model ID. `/settings` groups its sections into pages: the TUI's own settings sit under **General**, and plugins that declare a page get their own tab (`Tab` / `Shift+Tab`, or a click on the strip in fullscreen, switches pages; the strip is hidden when only one page exists). On DSH 0.1.7, `/settings` uses the TUI's actual Loader entry ID, including custom IDs. It requires matching profile dependencies with `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 3.18.3 or newer; an incompatible schema stops TUI startup with repair guidance instead of showing an uneditable settings page. Older hosts keep their legacy settings scope. The `dsh-tui` section of `/settings` is saved in `~/.dsh-tui/settings.json`, shared by every kernel; the first launch imports it once from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (and an older host's `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`) (see [configuration](docs/configuration.en.md#tui-configuration)). ```sh # Install the CLI and this plugin globally (ships the dsh-tui command) npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui # Start (first run auto-initializes the profile; needs pnpm) dsh-tui # Both `dsh-tui` and the short `dst` alias start the same TUI. dst ``` Manual alternative: `dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui`. Probes allow one pending reply (500 ms), skip resize/handoff, and pause for 60 seconds after an unanswered query or three repairs within 10 seconds. For explicit local iteration, set `DSH_TUI_DEV_FAST=1` (for example, `DSH_TUI_DEV_FAST=1 pnpm dev -- --no-launch`). A miss runs frozen install, `compile`, pack without repeating `prepare`, and isolated profile installation. An unchanged hit skips all four stages only while source/config and compiler-loader contents, Node/pnpm/npm/dsh versions, compiled and vendor output, the tarball, and the installed package/profile match. Replacing pnpm/npm/dsh without changing its reported version requires one normal (non-fast) development run. Internal document links such as `CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md` are fingerprinted; external, excluded, dangling or cyclic links and unreadable inputs disable reuse with a diagnostic. The monorepo development host (`pnpm tui`, `scripts/run.ts`) enables heap forensics only with `DSH_TUI_HEAP_WATCH=1`; unset it or use `0` to disable it. It samples every 15 seconds and takes one snapshot at each heap threshold of 1024, 1536, 2048, 2560 and 3072 MiB. Its own completed files in `$DSH_HOME` retain at most four 64-KiB logs and two snapshots totaling at most 1024 MiB. `DSH_TUI_HEAP_MAX_MB` changes the snapshot budget (integer 1–16384; invalid values use 1024). A single oversized snapshot is removed too; the latest diagnostic may therefore be a log only. Snapshot creation still blocks and uses extra memory and temporary disk space; this does not fix memory leaks. Files use a process-unique `dsh-tui-heap-watch-` prefix. Manual/legacy files are untouched; incomplete `.writing` files are removed only after their owner PID is confirmed absent. Live or uncheckable owners are preserved, and cleanup failures are nonfatal, so quotas apply to successful cleanup of completed files, not peak usage or uncertain crash leftovers. Reference implementation: `dsh-working-activity`. Exported plugin subcomponents are admitted using the nearest package manifest of their ESM entry, including import-only and conditional exports; they do not inherit an outer package's identity. A backend plugin (the `tui.dsh/v1alpha1` `Backend` contribution family) is in the kernel picker after a restart: the boot scans the bundles the profile declares, admits and registers each package-root `dsh-plugin.json` declaration, and reads the implementation from the package's `backend` export — importing that module only when the backend is actually selected. Each bundle may declare one backend, and its handler id must match the declaration. Entries awaiting authorization are neither probed nor loaded, including when explicitly requested at startup. Seam grading and API notes: [Plugin development](docs/plugins.en.md). The organization maintains the listing only; it does not endorse community plugins. Installing a plugin from inside the TUI: `/plugin install `. It goes through the host's profile plugin manager — a pre-install notice, a trust confirmation, cancellable progress, build-script approval and exact-version exemptions. Packages on the first-party feed this package ships (`tui-profile/feed/first-party.json`, pinned per release and decided offline) skip the trust confirmation, and only a spec that names that exact version qualifies: a bare name, a tag or a range is resolved again at install time, so it is confirmed with the person instead. What was confirmed is what gets installed — the run pins the exact `name@version` the inspection read — and a turn that is still running refuses the install (finish it, or `/new`, first). The same actions remain available from the CLI (`dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui …`). The confirmation lists the permissions the package declares; `Enter` installs **and grants** — the grant is written to `~/.dsh-tui/extension-grants.json` before the install starts, and a failed install rolls that write back. A registry package's declaration cannot be read before it lands, so a `grant` step follows a successful install: `Enter` grants, `Esc` skips (the install stays). Declared permissions this host does not know are skipped and named. On a terminal too short for a permission row, the list folds to a count or the key hint carries the count; the package identity, the notice and the keys stay visible. A spec names one of three things: ```sh /plugin install /path/to/repo /plugin install https://github.com/exam/ple.git /plugin install @scope/package@1.2.3 ``` Typing `/plugin install ` lists these three shapes in the completion popup, and the same shapes follow the installed names on `/plugin info `. They are examples, never candidates: `Tab` leaves the draft exactly as it is, and `Enter` runs the line you typed — the subcommand's usage line while the spec is still empty, your own spec once it is not. No example can therefore be inserted or installed by accident, and a real path that merely starts like one is never swallowed. During installation, `esc` attempts cancellation and keeps the pane open until the write settles; if cancellation is too late, it waits for the installation to finish. During exemption registration, it waits for the current write and stops subsequent grants and the retry. Exemptions already written remain. Failed installs show up to six redacted log lines; lines larger than 16 KiB are omitted with a notice. Managing what is installed: `/plugin remove `, `/plugin enable ` and `/plugin disable `. A bundle is a composition layer and a row is one patch entry, so the two are separate actions, and a bundle name is matched before any row identity. A module name shared by multiple rows requires a specific row ID. **Gate 2 refuses the three ways this app could switch itself off** — removing or disabling the bundle that provides it, the host layer `dsh-base`, or one of its own rows — and says which rule it broke, without calling the service at all; that holds whether or not hot reload is live, which is the path the host's own guard misses. `enable` is never refused by gate 2 (it is the repair action). Every enable and removal asks first; `disable` asks only about a host-layer row. The host does not attest installed package sources, so even an exact feed match requires confirmation before enabling. These three actions have no cancellation — the service offers none — so `esc` only closes the pane while the write finishes and reports itself into the transcript. No sandbox of its own: dsh-TUI uses the active DSH profile's filesystem, shell, sandbox and approval policies. Picking it in the picker first shows a risk confirmation (`Enter` enables, `Esc` goes back; in fullscreen its Enable / Go back rows are clickable); a typed `/permission auto` switches directly. The index is in memory and is built on the first search; nothing is written to disk. This app keeps the kernel Minimal preset at its single persistent-shell tool, so Minimal never shows these five tools or their usage guidance. **Git worktrees** (DSH, experimental): `/plugin list` advertises it; after `/plugin enable @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-worktree`, an agent gains `create_worktree`, which creates a new Git branch and a checkout under `.agents/worktrees/` of the current repository (from `HEAD` or a local revision; uncommitted files stay in the source checkout) and moves the session into it — the status line, Git branch and `@` completion follow, while the session stays registered under its project. Nothing is cleaned up: remove the checkout with `git worktree remove ` and the branch separately with `git branch -D ` (the agent leaves with `working_directory`; once the checkout is gone, the next request returns the session to the project). A leftover branch makes a later `create_worktree` with the same name fail. Calling it from inside a worktree nests the new checkout under that worktree. Moving does not change file permissions or already-open terminals. This app hides `create_worktree` from the kernel Minimal preset and the bundled liangshen preset: their persistent shell (liangshen's on macOS and Linux) keeps the directory it started in, so after a move it would still edit the source checkout. **Upstream auto-retry** (DSH): whenever a session binds (boot, `/model` switch, resume), the TUI seeds a retry policy — 5 attempts, transport-drop-aware failure codes including `STREAM_CLOSED` (a dropped upstream stream) — on **the provider route that session actually uses**, through the official `llm-pi-ai` settings section (the policy the kernel's `llm-retry` plugin executes). Only routes without an explicit `retryPolicy` are seeded — dormant channels are never written — and `upstreamRetry: false` in cordis.yml opts out. # dsh-TUI > 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式终端界面：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态、流式思考展示、双击 Esc 时间回溯、上下文进度条与 TPS 仪表。 > 零核心改动，只消费 DSH 的公开导出；正从「挂载型插件」演进为拥有自身入口与组装根的终端应用，届时 DSH 作为首方后端在进程内加载。安装即启用，卸载不留核心补丁。 回合空闲后，已完成目标自动从输入框上方隐藏；Todo 侧栏仍保留历史。`Ctrl+Q` 在工作中折叠待办，在空闲时隐藏／恢复目标与待办底部面板；空闲时点击待办标题也可隐藏。隐藏只影响当前展示，新目标／待办快照或会话会重新显示；`/goal clear` 不会清空待办。 分栏 diff 对纯新增、纯删除文件使用完整正文宽度，不保留空的另一栏。普通修改仍双栏显示；多文件分别决定布局，判断先于折叠与流式展开。 窄面板中的压缩状态保持单行：先省略阶段与取消提示，再缩短标签；计时只会完整显示，不拆开数字。 ## 功能亮点 没有可信 Component 身份的面板作为临时项：设置显示可读标题与本次运行的独立编号，勾选立即生效但不保存，无关设置修改会保留当前选择。旧 `actN:panel` 无法安全辨认来源，请移除占位项后重新选择当前面板。名称为 `actN` 的可信 Component 保留公开运行时地址；明确勾选时仅在持久偏好中使用 `component:actN:panel`，避免认领旧匿名项。 默认推理强度设置使用当前后端/模型声明的档位，包括自定义 ID。当前目录不支持的已存值仍显示并保留；目录加载中或不可用时仅可选自动。DSH 自动依次采用已存 `/effort`、配置默认值、模型默认。Claude/Codex 启动采用自动模式或恢复会话时保留后端偏好；在设置中主动选择自动会重置为模型默认。明确修改设置会作用于下一请求；不支持的偏好会提示回落，不会强行发送给当前路由。 通过 `@路径` 引用的图片与粘贴图片使用相同的准入、缩放和格式转换策略。调整提示采用实际保存的尺寸和格式；需要转换的动画会明确拒绝，避免静默丢帧。提及图片和暂存图片仍按原文顺序共享数量与实际保存字节额度。 恢复 DSH 会话时保留会话记录的推理强度，重新附着时保留其当前选择。保存的默认值用于新会话；用户明确执行 `/effort` 或修改默认推理强度设置，仍会作用于当前会话的下一请求。 - **像素鲸鱼娘** — 开屏三选一动画，点击唤醒；开始第一个任务后定格。 - **落地页与首次引导** — 每次普通启动先落在带**真输入框**的落地页（大字 + 鲸鱼 + 快捷入口，窄/矮终端自动整块降级；鲸娘图像按原生画布紧凑占位，避免图片与大字之间留出大块空白；默认开启，/settings 的 `launchpad` 关闭后直接进聊天页）；命令补全与聊天页一致：`Tab` 填入输入框，`Enter` 执行并清空。首次运行走四步向导（账号与模型接入 / 语言主题 / 模型工作区 / 快捷键），`/setup` 随时重跑；第一步可以直接登录订阅账号并接住新出现的模型（没有就不问、只有一个直接设为默认、多个才问），或经 `/provider` 向导写入 API key（由向导问切到启用的哪个模型，或保持当前模型）。 - **终端原生界面** — 流式 Markdown、工具卡、`/` 与 `@` 补全、`#L12-14` 行区间、历史搜索、中英界面。 - **原生光标** — 聚焦的文本输入框继承终端的光标形状、颜色、闪烁及已启用的动画或拖尾效果，inline 与 fullscreen 均支持。`/model` 选择器在提供商标签、模型行和推理档位之间移动时显示同样的光标，停稳 **0.5 秒后隐藏**；区域被裁剪时回落到模型行。会话管理界面也会在工作区栏、会话行与搜索框之间移动原生光标；输入时移到搜索框，导航时回到聚焦行。动画与拖尾效果在终端设置中配置。 - **图片** — Kitty/Sixel 缩略图，居中大图可缩放平移，粘贴前按限额适配，无图形时文字回退。Kitty 图片按预留格子的物理像素缩放，适配 HiDPI 终端。 - **Mermaid 图表** — ```` ```mermaid ```` 代码块画成 Unicode 字符图。 - **任务完成通知** — DSH、Claude、Codex 的实时任务成功结束，且没有排队的后续输入或活动目标时提醒。标题为「dsh-TUI · 任务已完成」，正文显示本轮最新回复的单行纯文本摘要（去掉 Markdown 样式，最多 200 字符）；OSC 777/9 还会按包含标题和协议开销的 2048 字节预算截短，保留完整字素；没有回复时只显示标题，BEL 只响铃。`/settings` → 对话：`taskNotifications` 可选 `unfocused`（默认，仅失焦）、`always`（每次完成）、`off`；`notificationMethod` 可选 `auto`（默认）、`osc9`、`bel`、`windows`。自动模式在 Ghostty/WezTerm（OSC 777）与 Kitty（OSC 99）分别显示标题与正文；iTerm2/Warp 与显式 `osc9` 将标题放在正文前；其他终端使用响铃，实际提醒取决于终端的通知/响铃设置。在本地 Windows 上，`auto` 解析为 `windows`，即系统原生通知：任务完成时弹出 toast；首次弹出会注册当前用户的 AppUserModelID（写 HKCU），弹出比任务结束晚约 3 秒（零安装路线要付的 PowerShell 冷启动代价）；DSH 会话所在运行中 profile 的外部 DSH 通知插件已启用且处于 active 时，dsh-TUI 让位（不弹也不响）；仅安装但已禁用的插件不会吞掉提醒；注册写不进去时回落到响铃，不会静默。`jumpBack`（Windows，默认关闭）让这些完成 toast 能回到完成任务的那个窗格；它依赖原生 toast 通道（`notificationMethod` = `windows`，本地 Windows 的 `auto` 就选它）。在 `/settings` → 对话里开启后，窗格标题末尾出现 `[dsh-tui:<16 位十六进制>]`，同一进程内标记不变；关闭后立即去掉后缀。开启期间，本进程会在开启时以及每次发出完成通知前刷新位于 `~/.dsh-tui/notify/jumpback/.json` 的标记文件（`schemaVersion: 1`、`marker`、`pid`、`startedAt`），第一条能承诺跳回的 toast 会注册当前用户的协议处理器（`URL Protocol` 与 `shell\open\command`）到 `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-tui`；正常退出会删掉本进程写过的文件；没有其它存活实例再用这个键时，也一并删掉键。只有发送前的探测恰好命中一个目标窗格（或一个标签标题）时，toast 才带 activation URI；点击时会再跑五项核验——同一个窗格、获得键盘焦点、标题仍含标记、窗口在前台、未最小化——任一项不成立就拒绝跳转，而不是跳到别处。目标已经不在的点击不改变任何东西。无法核验的布局——目标位于未选中标签、且不是该标签的获焦窗格，使用 `suppressApplicationTitle` 的 profile，或 Windows Terminal 以外的终端（在 Windows Terminal 1.24 实测）——发的是普通 toast，点击不改变任何窗口或焦点。开启期间，探测会让每条 toast 晚约半秒；开启后的第一条还可能等 helper 编译一次（几秒），而本机编译器持续失败时最多每五分钟重试一次。外部通知发送方可读取同一个标记文件，并把自己的 toast 指向 `dsh-tui:activate?m=`；该 URI 与文件格式是只读契约，本版不提供插件侧实现。SSH 会话的 `auto` 保留所连接终端的通知协议；显式 `windows` 仍选择运行主机的原生通知。tmux 的 OSC 通知需要 `set -g allow-passthrough on`，焦点报告需要 `set -g focus-events on`。不支持焦点报告的终端可选 `always`。回放、取消和失败不通知；inline 与 fullscreen 均支持。 - **LaTeX 公式** — `$…$` 与 `$$…$$` 公式转成 Unicode 文本，块级公式里的分数与上下限竖排；`mathRendering: image` 时在支持图形的终端里把块级公式与能压成一行的行内公式排成终端图片。 - **时间轴** — 全部回合可点；右栏时间线 / 滚动条 / 隐藏。 - **侧栏面板** — `Ctrl+B` 在聊天右侧展开面板列，拖拽分隔线即可调宽，默认启用全部 8 个内置面板，之后注册的插件面板也默认启用（`sidePanel.panels: '*'`；在 `/settings` 取消勾选会改成显式列表）；顶部以各面板符号显示未选中的页面，悬停显示名称。终端够宽才分栏，窄屏与 inline 模式保持整屏面板。`todo` 面板里长目标按面板宽度完整换行、状态单独一行；内容超出视口时，聚焦面板后用 `↑`/`↓` 或滚轮逐行滚动（全部待办也随滚动展开）（聊天页底部的紧凑目标行仍是单行省略 + 悬停全文）。 - **实时状态** — 工作动画、上下文条、TPS、缓存命中率、推理强度、token、本会话费用估算（主会话 + 子代理）、Git 与会话信息。标题、轨迹条和会话状态动画独立于正文更新，在空闲或失焦时暂停。 上下文条的填充长度跟随后端占用量，颜色按内容构成估算；压缩后清理过期估算，缺少分类时显示单块已用区域，条和 ctx 字段的悬停明细都报实测已用量。 - **唯一的会话管理界面** — `/resume` `/home` `/agentview` `/bg` `⌸`。 - **会话工作流** — `/new` `/compact` `/export` `/btw`、模型热切换、fork、回溯、vim、全屏草稿编辑器。 `/btw` 在侧栏无法显示时回退到浮层；主任务问卷与全屏草稿编辑器优先接管，侧问与草稿保持原样。 - **IDE 选区通道** — VS Code 里选中的代码进 prompt。 - **DSH 集成** — presets、技能、MCP、目标、待办、子代理、问卷。 - **账号登录** — 标准 profile 提供 pi-ai 的 ChatGPT/Codex、Claude、Grok OAuth（可用时还有 OpenAI 直连与 Meta Muse）；DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+ 还通过宿主服务提供 DeepSeek 浏览器登录，路由为 `deepseek-account`。通过 `/provider` 或 `/auth` 使用，无需另装插件。 仅更新 profile 而留下已挂载 `dsh-tui-auth` 的旧全局 TUI 补丁时，本地登录也会按需启动官方 loopback 回调监听器；SSH 固定端口转发仍需对齐全局安装包。 - **扩展** — 浏览器交互、computer use 等。 - **为长会话设计** — 事件驱动投影、虚拟化、有界缓存。 键位与命令：[交互与命令](docs/interaction.md)。其余见[文档索引](docs/README.md)。 修改无关设置不会隐藏已注册的插件侧栏面板；编辑已启用面板列表仍会应用你的明确选择。 工作区侧栏与会话管理器按同一规则计数：包含当前会话，排除空日志、子代理、当前分支祖先及归档会话。已登记但无可见会话的工作区保留为零；加载与读取失败单独显示，按 `r` 刷新。 DSH 0.2.1 起，Agent 把会话切到别的目录（`working_directory` 工具或 Git worktree）后，状态栏、Git 分支、`@` 补全、`!` 命令、点击的路径、技能命令与已加载上下文都会跟随，`/resume` 后也一样；会话仍登记在启动时的项目下。移动前已渲染的卡片里的相对路径，在移动后点击时按会话当前目录解析；绝对路径不受影响。 全屏鼠标选区归属于手势起始栏，包括聊天、侧栏及左右 diff。对角拖选、选词与选行只复制该栏；各栏软换行独立拼接，保留原文换行；拖动分隔线只调整宽度。 ## 界面预览

## 快速开始 ### Windows 一键安装（x64） 从 [Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/releases) 下载 `dsh-tui-setup-win-x64.exe` 双击运行。免管理员、全离线，也无需预先装 Node 或 DSH。 ### 命令行安装 前置条件：安装 [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/zh-cn) 与 [deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)。`deepseek-official` API key 路由需要 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`；DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+ 的标准 profile 也可用 `/auth login deepseek-account` 登录，再通过 `/model` 选择独立的账号路由。其他支持的账号可在启动后通过 `/provider` 或 `/auth` 登录。 主适配目标为 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`，已接入新版 Shell API、V4 会话消息、声明式预设与 profile 设置；旧受支持版本保留兼容路径。迁移说明见[配置参考](docs/configuration.md)。 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 及之后还可在 `/settings` 选择 DeepSeek 搜索 / 抓取 API、修改端点与结果数。 分区支持自定义 Loader 行 ID，可直接输入 API key，密钥以掩码显示并保存到 DSH 凭据库。 官方 Flash 模型显示 `1017` 发布标记，模型 ID 仍为 `deepseek-flash`。 `/settings` 按页签组织：TUI 自己的设置位于「常规」页，插件声明的页单独成签 （`Tab` / `Shift+Tab` 或全屏下点击页签切换；只有一页时不显示页签）。 DSH 0.1.7 的 `/settings` 使用 TUI 实际的 Loader 行 ID，也支持自定义 ID。 profile 依赖须配套，包含 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 3.18.3 或更新版本； Schema 不兼容时，TUI 在启动阶段报错并提示修复安装，不再显示不可编辑的设置页。 旧 host 继续使用原有设置 scope。 `/settings` 的 `dsh-tui` 分区保存在 `~/.dsh-tui/settings.json`，所有内核共用；第一次启动时 从 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（以及旧版 host 的 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`）一次性导入（见[配置参考](docs/configuration.md#tui-配置)）。 ```sh # 安装（全局，自带 dsh-tui 命令） npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui # 启动（首次运行自动初始化 profile，需要 pnpm） dsh-tui # dst 是短别名，启动同一个 TUI dst ``` 手动安装：跑仓库根目录的 `install.sh`，或 `dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui`。之后 `dsh-tui` 与 `dsh --profile dsh-tui` 等价。 > **新用户提示**：pnpm ≥11 默认拦截带安装脚本的依赖，报 `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`。更新时还会忽略异平台原生包（`@img/sharp-*` 与 Claude SDK 的 `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-*`），只取本机平台的二进制。`/update` 与 `dsh-tui update` 都会自动写好这两份配置，无需手工处理。更新**从不**顺手安装 Claude SDK：只有你在内核选择器里选中该后端时才会装，且只装当前平台对应的版本。细节见[安装与快速开始](docs/getting-started.md#pnpm-安装脚本拦截与异平台原生包)。 TUI 启动后会在后台检查新版本，不阻塞首帧。有更新时输入 `/update` 一键对齐整套（TUI、全局 dsh 引擎、全局启动器），自动重启并恢复当前会话；TUI 与引擎不兼容或引擎不可启动时明确拒绝；若 registry 上有超出本 TUI 验证范围的新 dsh，会说明在等 TUI 适配，不会安装未验证的引擎。启动器对齐通常是 best effort，但引擎已推进后若启动器对齐失败，会拒绝重启并打印修复命令；只操作可证明的全局安装；项目内 npm/npx 包、归属有歧义的别名和 pnpm 多成员组均保持不变。profile 叠加机制、源码构建与常见问题见[安装与快速开始](docs/getting-started.md)。 ### CLI 子命令 自动化入口：`dst -p "任务"`、`dst run --json`、`dst session list --json`。 独立引擎不加载 TUI，也不继承其 profile/偏好；执行与查询仍由官方 DSH headless/服务拥有（当前验证 0.2.0-rc.2、0.2.1-rc.2、0.2.1-rc.3、0.2.1-rc.4 与 0.2.1-rc.5）。`dst cli --help` 查看全部命令， `dst dsh <参数...>` 原样转交官方。协议、限制、会话恢复边界与 Node/Python/PowerShell 示例见[自动化 CLI](docs/cli.md)。 | 命令 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dsh-tui` / `dst` | 启动 TUI；短别名是同一个程序 | | `dsh-tui --resume [id]` · `dsh-tui update` · `dsh-tui doctor` | 恢复会话 · 一次对齐 TUI、dsh 引擎与全局启动器 · 环境体检 | | `dsh-tui safe` | 只读诊断、插件清单与修复指引；`safe --rescue` 创建干净的救援 profile | | `dsh-tui version` · `dsh-tui help` | 启动器与 profile 版本、用法；没装 dsh 时这两条也能用 | 前置 DSH 选项（如 `--dump-config`、`--patch <路径>`）原样转发， 其余参数交给 `dsh --profile dsh-tui` 中的应用。使用 `dsh-tui -- --resume=sid-1 ./notes` 可将 `--resume=sid-1 ./notes` 作为字面提示词， 不选择恢复会话或工作区。直接调用 DSH 时，使用 `dsh --profile dsh-tui -- -- --resume=sid-1 ./notes`：第一个 `--` 属于 DSH， 第二个属于应用。宿主选项可以放在字面提示词之前： `dsh-tui 的文件、Shell、sandbox 与 approval 策略。权限预设来自 DSH `permissionPresets` registry。 **权限记忆**（三个内核都有）：Claude 与 Codex 后端把 `/permission` 选择存在 `~/.dsh-tui/backends//prefs.json`；DSH 的选择存在 `~/.dsh-tui/permission.json`。任何一次持久的预设切换（选择器、手敲 `/permission`、Shift+Tab 静态模式、官方命令自行完成的切换）都会更新记忆；从未自定义过权限面的会话将以上次的选择启动——同样走官方切换路径。这里的"未自定义"以用户动作为准：合成层会在每个新会话创建时写入自己的默认预设，那些事件不算用户选择。计划模式的临时切换与实验性的自动授权审查（见下）不记入；`DSH_PERMISSION_MODE` 是本次启动的初始权限面，显式设置时优先于该文件；名册已不提供的身份会被跳过。 **自动授权审查**（DSH，实验性）：`/plugin list` 会列出它；用 `/plugin enable @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` 开启后，`auto` 预设（显示为「自动授权审查」，带 `EXP` 标记）即时出现在 `/permission` 及其补全里，移除插件后即时消失。它只对当前会话生效：模型在每次工具调用执行前审查，没有文件沙箱，每次调用额外一次模型请求；其审批显示本地化原因，子代理中的拒绝显示为「自动授权审查拒绝，未执行」。在选择器里选中它会先出风险确认（`Enter` 启用，`Esc` 返回；全屏下「启用 / 返回」两行可点击）；手敲 `/permission auto` 直接切换。当前会话选过它一次之后，选择器不再弹确认，Shift+Tab 也不再跳过它。 **会话搜索**（DSH，实验性）：`/plugin list` 会列出它；用 `/plugin enable @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-search` 开启后，Agent 多出 5 个只读检索工具（`session_search`、`session_event_search`、`session_trace`、`session_event_trace`、`session_event_read`），可检索同一工作区的历史会话——跨会话访问要求 `cwd` 完全一致。索引只在内存里，首次搜索时建立，不落盘。本应用让内核的极简模式保持它那一个持久 shell `.agents/worktrees/<名称>` 下新建 Git 分支与工作树（基于 `HEAD` 或指定的本地版本；未提交的改动留在原工作区），再把会话切进去——状态栏、Git 分支与 `@` 补全随之跟随，会话仍登记在原项目下。工具卡显示为 `Worktree("<分支>")`，正文是工作树路径与基于的版本。不会自动清理：工作树用 `git worktree remove <路径>`
